email.subject: Harbor Pros Dentistry: mobile visitors are bouncing
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked Harbor Pros Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: it's not set up for mobile, so anyone searching for a dentist on their phone (most people) gets a broken layout and probably leaves; and there's no office hours listed, so people can't tell if you're open before calling or walking in.

There's also heavy, slow-loading images and an outdated footer, but the first two are the ones actually driving people away.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how I'd fix it? No obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
